title: Edgar Fouche's 1998 TR-3B testimony: projects moved to Dugway

tellings.quote: super weird meta thing. Whoa. But even like Edgar Fuche, whose primary testimony in 1998 revolves around um the TR3B talks about hey you know a lot of projects were moved out to Dougway proven route.

plain: A man named Edgar Fouche is said to have stated, in testimony from 1998, that many secret projects were moved to Dugway Proving Ground, a military testing range in Utah. Most of that testimony is about the TR-3B, a claimed secret triangle-shaped aircraft. The online researcher UAPGerb points to it on the show as one more account placing hidden work at Dugway.
